title: the candidate-pool budget curve
purpose: answer the objection that the new-node penalty lambda was not removed but moved into the candidate-pool budget, by measuring the curve instead of the two-point stress test in code/tests/test_batch.py
eviction_rule: drop the live candidate with the lowest accrued escrow G, never one touched by the current record (engine.py:207-221)
protocol: EscrowGraph + BatchObjective(g).install(); repair() every 100 records; final repair(full=True)
protocol_note: every run goes through escrow.protocol.new_run(cand_pool_cap=c); the cand_pool_cap keyword was added to protocol.new_run and protocol.run_stream as a defaulted additive argument, so no existing caller and no default changed
budgets_added_why: the requested grid jumps 1024 to 4096, which put the Wikipedia and Lazada plateau exactly at the shipped default; 128, 512, 2048 and 3072 locate the plateau inside that jump

metrics.K: final node count after the final full repair pass
metrics.ARI: adjusted Rand index of record labels against the truth; background = one cluster
metrics.mints: len(g.mint_log), releases attempted over the stream (nodes can later merge)
metrics.background: records that end in no node
metrics.peak_pool: max len(g.pool) observed after any record
metrics.evictions: exact count of candidate accounts dropped by the eviction rule
metrics.seconds: wall time of the stream plus its repair passes

reading.summary: On every stream tested the answer stops moving at or below a budget of 3072, which is below the shipped default of 4096, so the default is on the flat part of the curve for all four. Smallest budget that reaches the plateau, per stream: twogroup 128, planted8 256, wikipedia 2048, lazada 3072. The budget stops mattering once it exceeds the peak number of live candidate accounts the stream produces, which is a property of the stream and not a tuned value: peaks here are twogroup 74, planted8 468, wikipedia 1921, lazada 2378. Below the plateau the budget does move the answer, and not monotonically: on Wikipedia the mean ARI rises to a peak at a small budget and settles lower at the plateau. From a budget of 128 up, the ARI moves with the budget by twogroup 0.0 against 0.0 with the seed at the default, planted8 0.0 against 0.0 with the seed at the default, wikipedia 0.1387 against 0.32 with the seed at the default, lazada 0.0001 against 0.0002 with the seed at the default. Scope: these four streams are 320 to 3,000 records. The cap is documented to bind on the full Lazada stream (21,365 records) and on MusicBrainz 20K (results/mb20k_full2.json records the cap raised from 4096 to 32768 mid-run), so the flat-part claim is made for streams of this size and is not a claim about arbitrarily long streams.
